coordinateSpace: Source node TRS applied; glTF Y-up metres. Preview only changes basis to Blender Z-up; no placement, scaling, root snapping or deformation.
sourceWindSemantics: Unknown; raw source bytes remain authenticated and are not used as root, phase or parent identifiers.
notes: Root centres are means of explicitly selected support corners, except named basal components which retain their unreviewed proposal root. These are candidates for textured review, not approved recipes.
The cotton central crown intentionally moves all central stalks and detached flower geometry together. It does not infer which stalk owns each flower fragment.
Every source triangle is assigned once. Group tint preserves the material alpha cutoff. Root markers are annotations, not source geometry.
Near/mid fern source geometry matches, but every proposal hash is bound independently. Cotton has explicit separate near/mid triangle maps.
This file is not accepted by ground_cover_roots.py --review. Review, export/import identity and drawn-terrain contact remain outstanding.

billboardPlan.status: proposal-only; no billboard in this harness
billboardPlan.anchor: Carry a variant-level logical crown anchor from the reviewed near mesh into every LOD. The billboard plane boundary is not a root: fern v0's bottom is about -0.16 m and includes transparent padding and frond silhouette.
billboardPlan.schema: Add an explicit bounded virtual support point representation for billboard intent, alongside the existing corner-supported stem representation. Bind the virtual anchor and support points to the near geometry/review hashes and logical plant key. Never synthesize roots from an alpha bounding box or lowest polygon vertex.
billboardPlan.transform: Resolve the variant anchor against drawn terrain once, then rotate the billboard's authored vertex-minus-anchor around that resolved anchor. Camera-facing rotation must not move the anchor. Preserve authored vertical and horizontal offsets; no bottom-edge snapping.
billboardPlan.groups: A far cotton billboard represents the complete clump, including the separate near basal blades. Its recipe needs a reviewed clump footprint and maximum support-height/crease difference; a single far plane cannot reproduce independent near-blade deformation.
billboardPlan.validation: Review the actual alpha texture and virtual anchor together. Render near/mid/far overlap on flat and two-direction slopes, terrain morph/seam/rebase, and camera orbit. Reject the complete billboard coherently if required support is missing. Do not silently stretch a billboard over unsupported soil.
billboardPlan.admission: No schema or runtime admission until the selected virtual support points, LOD correspondence and rendered transitions are explicitly reviewed.
